k2501811481.notes: Dark fascia on a corner building in Pokhara, seen from a car; small address lines beside and below are illegible. A second 'BATHROOM PLANET' board lower down and the yellow 'Himstar' sign at left are distractors.

k576438486.notes: Bank fascia in Pokhara in hazy, washed-out light. The small Devanagari line under the name and the branch text at right ('New Road, Pokhara Branch' with a Devanagari line) are too faint to transcribe. 'Prudential Insurance Co. Ltd.' above and 'New DIAMOND' at right are distractors.

k576438526.notes: Red bank fascia in Pokhara, hazy. The tiny tagline under the name and the faint Devanagari text on the orange end panel are not transcribed. A blurred passer-by occupies the lower right.

k576438566.notes: Raised dark letters on a white fascia (furniture showroom), New Road, Pokhara; 'MADE IN / POKHARA' is stacked at the right. Distractors: 'SANSKRITI TRADING HOUSE', the 'ईश्वर मेडिकल हल' pharmacy sign and SALE banners.

c127694372.notes: Small blue/white board at a distance in a field with haystacks, marking the Sagarmatha (Nijgadh) airport construction site. A third small line (municipality/ward address) is too small to read and is not labelled. Lens flare at right.

c192981789.notes: Yellow trail junction board in Shivapuri Nagarjun National Park; only the central circle (the place name) is labelled. Directional panels around it are distractors: NAGI GUMBA (नागी गुम्बा), HELIPAD (हेलिप्याड), SHIVAPURI PEAK (शिवपुरी चुचुरो), BAGHOWAR (बाघद्वार), plus 'HELP US TO KEEP THE NATIONAL PARK CLEAN'. Shaded forest, slightly soft focus.

c200557429.notes: Hand-painted shop board, Patan (Lalitpur), with cables crossing its right end; a small phone number at lower right is not labelled. Distractors: 'ESPRESSO Coffee Available' board, partly visible red script lightbox ('...Temple') above, paintings.

lines.latin: Devi Ma Ayurved Gramin Chikitsalaya (Devi Ma Ayurveda Rural Hospital)

c20188740.notes: Hand-painted hospital board, Sipadol, Bhaktapur. The Devanagari title is transcribed as painted, including the anusvara over वें in आयुर्वेंद and the spelling ग्रामिण. Smaller lines not labelled: 'Reg. No.:- 704/7-063', 'S.W.C. No:- 20084', 'देवी माँ कुञ्जद्वारा संचालित / Run by DEVI MA KUNJA', 'स्थापित:- २०५९', the Devanagari place line (a small mark over the first syllable is unclear), and the round logo.

c20450743.notes: Green trilingual locality sign, Kathmandu, shot from below; dented, with a damaged spot on ट. The top line is in Ranjana (Nepal Lipi) script, which has no Unicode encoding, so it is not transcribed and is not part of the lines.

c20463614.notes: Green trilingual locality sign (Tyora Tol), Kathmandu; same series as c20450743 but a different place. The top line is in Ranjana script (no Unicode encoding) and is not transcribed. Peeling paint over the lower half.

c2881761.reason: busy Thamel street view with dozens of signs; no single main target

c37511567.notes: Red-on-white overhead hospital banner, Jiri, Dolakha. Smaller header lines (नेपाल सरकार, ministry and department names) and a phone number cut off at the right edge are not labelled. Nepal emblem at left, 'H' box at right.

c40582244.notes: Two hand-painted yellow boards behind a log fence. In राष्ट्रिय the hand-painted ट in the conjunct ष्ट्रि has a tail that could also be read as ड; the standard spelling ट is used. The stapit date is in Devanagari digits.

c49999919.notes: Vinyl school direction banner, Jorpati, Kathmandu. Smaller lines not labelled: motto in quotes under the logo, 'दुर सञ्चार अगाडि' (in front of the telecom office), phone number 'फोन: ४९१२२६७', and the arrow panel '६० मिटर अगाडि' (60 metres ahead).

lines.latin: yahan khana, nasta ra basnako (here food, snacks and lodging)

c56232788.notes: Hand-painted black board over a roadside eatery; the address 'Zero Kilo' and 'Muglin' suggest Mugling rather than Melamchi as in the source title. The sentence ends with a slash-like danda. Distractors: red fascia 'प्रकाशभोजनाल[य]' (last letter hidden behind the board), Tuborg, Pepsi and F&N crates, painter credit at lower left. A child is seated in the foreground (incidental).
